why: Neither sofa is the dark green velvet the client asked for. Every other piece in B fits the classic brief: wingback chairs, a Persian medallion rug, a dark wood coffee table, a linen-shade lamp and a gold-framed mirror sized for the mantel, all in a cohesive palette suited to the molded room. A mixes a mid-century sofa, an industrial tray table and a chrome glam lamp with a dark shade that clashes with the traditional setting.
